overview: Clockwork Pinball is a neon pinball table with a steel ball, moving flippers, a spinning gear and a spring plunger. Bumpers and posts kick the ball while three upper lanes build a scoring multiplier. The challenge is to control real ball momentum and keep each of three balls away from the drain.
rules: Charge and release the spring plunger to serve a ball; use the flippers to keep it in play.
Bumpers, posts and the spinning gear award points through contact.
Lighting all three top lanes awards a bonus and raises the multiplier, up to five.
Draining a ball spends one of three balls and resets the multiplier; the run ends when none remain.
controls: A/D or arrows operate the flippers; controller triggers/bumpers also work.
Hold Space/controller A and release to plunge.
story: This is a mechanics-led puzzle or activity; the available game source does not establish a narrative campaign or named story cast.
